<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="375" height="812" viewBox="0 0 375 812">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="812" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">9:41</text>
    <line x1="307" y1="22" x2="307" y2="27" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="312" y1="19" x2="312" y2="27" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="317" y1="16" x2="317" y2="27" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="328" cy="22" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="24" x2="334" y2="28" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="342" y="16" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="345" y="19" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#0F172A"/>
    <rect x="364" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#0F172A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Account page behind dialog -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,73 24,80 31,87" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="86" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">Account</text>
    <text x="24" y="122" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Update your password to keep your account secure.</text>

    <text x="24" y="165" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Old Password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="174" width="327" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#E03C4C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="40" y="204" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">••••••••••••</text>
    <circle cx="329" cy="197" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="202" x2="334" y2="192" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="24" y="244" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#E03C4C">Password incorrect</text>

    <text x="24" y="282" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">New Password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="291" width="327" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="40" y="321" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Enter new password</text>
    <circle cx="329" cy="314" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="319" x2="334" y2="309" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="24" y="379" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Confirm Password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="388" width="327" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="40" y="418" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Re-enter new password</text>
    <circle cx="329" cy="411" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="416" x2="334" y2="406" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <g>
      <rect x="24" y="472" width="327" height="56" rx="10" fill="#52B6DF"/>
      <text x="187.5" y="507" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Update Password</text>
    </g>
    <line x1="24" y1="568" x2="351" y2="568" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="24" y="603" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Password tips</text>
    <text x="24" y="630" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Use at least 8 characters with a mix of letters</text>
    <text x="24" y="652" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">and numbers for a stronger password.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="764" width="375" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="375" y2="764" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g transform="translate(38,774)">
      <polygon points="0,8 9,0 18,8" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="4" y="8" width="10" height="9" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="9" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(119,774)">
      <circle cx="9" cy="5" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="9" cy="15" rx="8" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="9" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(202,774)">
      <rect x="1" y="2" width="16" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <polygon points="5,15 5,19 9,15" fill="#64748B"/>
      <circle cx="6" cy="8" r="1" fill="#64748B"/>
      <circle cx="9" cy="8" r="1" fill="#64748B"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="1" fill="#64748B"/>
      <text x="9" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Messages</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(302,774)">
      <line x1="2" y1="5" x2="16" y2="5" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="2" y1="10" x2="16" y2="10" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="2" y1="15" x2="16" y2="15" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="9" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Dimmed overlay -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="812" fill="#334155" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Confirmation modal shadow and container -->
  <rect x="17" y="222" width="343" height="365" rx="25" fill="#0F172A" opacity="0.12"/>
  <rect x="16" y="220" width="343" height="365" rx="25" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Blue key illustration -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="187.5" cy="294" r="48" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
    <circle cx="174" cy="286" r="17" fill="none" stroke="#4178D4" stroke-width="7"/>
    <circle cx="174" cy="286" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="187" y="280" width="48" height="12" rx="6" fill="#4178D4"/>
    <rect x="221" y="290" width="9" height="14" rx="2" fill="#4178D4"/>
    <rect x="208" y="290" width="9" height="10" rx="2" fill="#4178D4"/>
    <line x1="187" y1="286" x2="201" y2="286" stroke="#4178D4" stroke-width="7"/>
    <circle cx="238" cy="286" r="4" fill="#86CCE9"/>
  </g>

  <text x="187.5" y="371" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">Account updated</text>
  <text x="187.5" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Your password has been changed</text>
  <text x="187.5" y="431" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">successfully. You can now sign in</text>
  <text x="187.5" y="455" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">with your new credentials.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="36" y="499" width="303" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="529" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#316D86">Continue</text>
  </g>
</svg>
